children: ETTEPLAN ISSUES A PROFIT WARNING AND LOWERS ITS GUIDANCE FOR 2026
REVENUE FOR 2026 IS ESTIMATED TO BE €355-365 MILLION
OPERATING PROFIT (EBIT) FOR 2026 IS ESTIMATED TO BE €16.5-20 MILLION
EARLIER GUIDANCE: REVENUE FOR 2026 TO BE €360-375 MILLION
EARLIER GUIDANCE: OPERATING PROFIT (EBIT) FOR 2026 TO BE €19-22 MILLION
LOWERS ESTIMATES DUE TO SLOWER-THAN-EXPECTED DEVELOPMENT OF MARKET DEMAND AND BUSINESS OPERATIONS
